fact: The Minister told WTDC-25 (17-18 November 2025) that the National Broadband Plan is part of Zimbabwe's policy set and that over five years the Universal Service Fund connected 1700 schools and 1219 health institutions, with broadband penetration at 79%.
title: Zimbabwe's Information Communication Technology Policy Statement
publisher: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services (ITU WTDC-25)
